name: prompt-refiner
description: Hybrid prompt linter — deterministic Node detector for 8 of 13 rules (PR001, PR004, PR006, PR007, PR008, PR-INJ01–03), LLM model layer for the semantic rest (PR002, PR003, PR005, PR009, PR010). Lint, don't rewrite. Markdown or JSON output, suppression comments, baseline mode, conformance corpus (17 cases), CI recipes. Never imposes a framework, never asks clarifying questions, never auto-rewrites.
